scripts.start:bg: nohup node dist/index.js > logs/daemon.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .daemon.pid && echo "aidevflow daemon started (PID: $(cat .daemon.pid))"
scripts.stop:bg: kill $(cat .daemon.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm -f .daemon.pid && echo "aidevflow daemon stopped" || (rm -f .daemon.pid && echo "Process was not running")
scripts.status:bg: [ -f .daemon.pid ] && ps -p $(cat .daemon.pid) > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "aidevflow daemon is RUNNING (PID: $(cat .daemon.pid))" || echo "aidevflow daemon is NOT running"
